remarks: Sophisticated Style and Unbeatable Location - Newfield/Pepper Ridge.   Some homes just have *it* - that rare blend of style, space, and location that makes you stop and pick up the phone. This is that home.  Nestled in one of Stamford's most sought-after neighborhoods, this beautifully maintained 3-4 bedroom, 1.5 bath residence has been thoughtfully updated for the way people live today. From the striking new front door to the showpiece custom eat-in kitchen - featuring stainless appliances, custom cabinetry, and direct access to a brand-new private deck - every detail has been considered.  The sun-drenched living room impresses with vaulted ceilings and a cozy fireplace, while gleaming hardwood floors flow throughout. Need flexibility? The lower level delivers - a spacious family room plus a fourth bedroom or home office, perfect for guests or remote work. Upstairs offers three spacious bedrooms and a newer bath. Best of all? **Everything has already been done.** New roof, new deck, new front door, repointed chimney, and newer driveway mean zero headaches from day one. Gas heat, central air, city water, and sewer complete the package.  And the location? Walk to everything that makes Stamford living so desirable - shops, parks, and top-rated schools, all steps away.  Move-in ready. Meticulously updated. Perfectly positioned.  *This is the one you've been waiting for.*
